name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 13 times in 5 visits over 41 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 38 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-11-03, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 5.01 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
